scope: Maintainer assessment of bounded local research progress; file integrity is not independent production acceptance

requirements.name: Backend services
requirements.local_progress: Local authenticated research API, histories, solver, document Q&A and bounded investigation endpoints are implemented.
requirements.remaining: Operational case/outcome services, durable jobs and reviewed deployed API acceptance remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Integrated deployed APIs pass success, failure and authorization tests.

requirements.name: Persistent database
requirements.local_progress: SQLite migrations, transactional histories, ownership and restart/restoration checks are implemented.
requirements.remaining: Managed database deployment, capacity/availability targets and production concurrency/failover qualification remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Records survive service restarts; integrity, migration and concurrent-write tests pass.

requirements.name: Authorized datasets
requirements.local_progress: Official BTS January–May 2025 imports have source/hash provenance and 2,835,101 historical US flight records.
requirements.remaining: UAE airline operational data, document permissions and purpose-specific source-rights review remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Reviewed licenses/permissions and reproducible source manifests.

requirements.name: Data ingestion
requirements.local_progress: BTS batch ingestion validates schemas, reconciles counts and prevents duplicate archive imports.
requirements.remaining: Scheduled incremental collectors, quarantine workflows, orchestration and operational replay remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Successful ingestion with reconciled counts and recoverable dependency failures.

requirements.name: Big-data processing
requirements.local_progress: A local million-row SQLite dataset and chronological training pipeline are measured.
requirements.remaining: Representative distributed processing, partitioning and bounded-query resource/load qualification remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Actual record counts, storage, runtime and resource measurements.

requirements.name: Data science models
requirements.local_progress: Two delay-classification experiments were evaluated with chronological holdouts; v2 passed its research protocol. An offline route-outcome clustering experiment also records train-only selection, initialization agreement and a fixed later-period comparison with substantial assignment change. A verified recorded-summary dashboard now provides period/group/coverage/transition exploration and JSON export. A bounded read-only historical route lookup adds cohort rates, nominal Wilson uncertainty intervals and explicit sparse-comparison handling.
requirements.remaining: Broader agreed regression/forecasting/sentiment/anomaly use cases, semantic/business validation of route segments and UAE operational validation remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Versioned artifacts and measured leakage-safe holdout, baseline and cohort evaluations.

requirements.name: Prediction deployment
requirements.local_progress: Historical scenario inference loads a verified v2 artifact, checks input scope and abstains on unsupported requests.
requirements.remaining: Operational model monitoring, calibration, service objectives and demonstrated model rollback remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Inference, fallback, monitoring and model-rollback tests pass.

requirements.name: Generative AI
requirements.local_progress: Six public project documents support local neural retrieval and generated answers with citation/abstention checks.
requirements.remaining: Authorized aviation corpus coverage, robust grounding/security evaluation and deployed permission boundaries remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Measured grounding, citation, abstention, permission and injection-resistance evaluation.

requirements.name: Agent execution
requirements.local_progress: A bounded agent runs through a saved single-process SQLite queue with owner checks, progress polling, waiting cancellation, deduplication and persisted checkpoints.
requirements.remaining: External worker isolation, distributed leases/failover, running-tool cancellation, broader task-completeness evaluation and operational acceptance remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Actual authorized tool runs, failures, resume behavior and human checkpoints are tested.

requirements.name: Mathematical optimization
requirements.local_progress: A synthetic gate-allocation mixed-integer solver has independent feasibility checks, comparisons and persisted proposals.
requirements.remaining: Real authorized airline constraints/data, scale and operational acceptance remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Reproducible computed candidates, infeasibility cases and verifier evidence.

requirements.name: Connected business workflows
requirements.local_progress: Research tools share a local identity/database; four browser-local operational journeys remain synthetic.
requirements.remaining: Persistent cross-service incident-to-outcome journeys and real operational integrations remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Critical journeys pass across deployed services with shared persistent identifiers.

requirements.name: Authentication
requirements.local_progress: Local Argon2 password accounts, expiring sessions and revocation are implemented.
requirements.remaining: Managed user/service identity, MFA, lifecycle ownership and HTTPS deployment remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Identity lifecycle, session expiry and revocation tests pass.

requirements.name: Authorization
requirements.local_progress: Server-enforced admin/researcher/viewer roles and owner-scoped research records have negative tests.
requirements.remaining: Applicable tenant isolation, purpose policy and separation-of-duties acceptance remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Negative tests prove unauthorized requests and retrieval are denied.

requirements.name: Human approval controls
requirements.local_progress: Research report review is tied to the exact report hash and mechanical evidence coverage.
requirements.remaining: Operational proposal expiry, transactional approval separation, changed-proposal controls and business authorization remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Changed/expired proposals and duplicate/conflicting decisions are rejected.

requirements.name: Protected audit
requirements.local_progress: Local research histories preserve selected inputs, outputs and actor ownership; they are mutable database records.
requirements.remaining: Protected audit retention, correlation and independently reviewed tamper resistance remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Relevant actions can be reconstructed; unauthorized modification is prevented.

requirements.name: Security and privacy
requirements.local_progress: Local authorization, CSRF/Origin checks, restricted tool routes and encrypted local recovery are implemented.
requirements.remaining: Independent security/privacy review, protected secrets lifecycle, export/retention controls and vulnerability qualification remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Reviewed controls, security results and resolved material findings.

requirements.name: Production deployment
requirements.local_progress: A loopback Docker Desktop release runs non-root/read-only containers with measured health/isolation checks.
requirements.remaining: Cloud environment, TLS, controlled production configuration and reviewed release acceptance remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Deployed environment has passing readiness/health checks and reviewed configuration.

requirements.name: Monitoring
requirements.local_progress: Admin monitoring shows bounded API response metrics and fresh/stale component checks with local snapshots.
requirements.remaining: Independent uptime, centralized protected telemetry, AI/pipeline quality signals and owned external alerts remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Working measured dashboards, actionable alerts and response procedures.

requirements.name: Backup and recovery
requirements.local_progress: Plain and encrypted local drills restored 2,835,101 flights, accounts, model/index and exact prediction parity; restored sessions were revoked.
requirements.remaining: Off-site storage, independent key recovery, agreed RPO/RTO targets and independent environment drills remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Successful drills measure recovery time and data loss against agreed targets.

requirements.name: Rollback
requirements.local_progress: A pinned application-image rollback and return-to-candidate drill passed on a separate restored volume, with health, row-count, account, artifact and prediction checks.
requirements.remaining: Database downgrade, model/prompt rollback, independent production release/failover and zero-downtime compatibility qualification remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrated rollback preserves acceptable integrity and availability.

requirements.name: Performance and accessibility
requirements.local_progress: Selected desktop/mobile views have been inspected; a bounded anonymous loopback HTTP sample measured 90 valid responses with endpoint latency distributions. No full accessibility, authenticated workload or capacity qualification is claimed. A separate native authenticated HTTP drill measured concurrent real-model predictions with temporary accounts/state; deployed sustained/AI workloads remain unqualified.
requirements.remaining: Agreed performance objectives, sustained representative authenticated/AI workloads, resource/queue contention, keyboard/screen-reader review and device matrix remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Reviewed results meet agreed targets and material accessibility defects are resolved.

requirements.name: Integrated acceptance testing
requirements.local_progress: Automated backend/proxy tests and recorded real-data model/AI/recovery checks cover the bounded local research scope. A disposable native HTTP drill additionally checks concurrent real-model predictions, persisted-row reconciliation, owner/role/CSRF controls, duplicate races and session revocation.
requirements.remaining: Reviewed deployed critical journeys, security/load results and resolution of material defects remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: Reviewed real execution evidence with critical defects resolved.

requirements.name: Operational documentation
requirements.local_progress: Local setup, data/model, AI, monitoring and recovery runbooks are maintained with explicit limitations.
requirements.remaining: Independent operator walkthrough, production incident ownership and deployment/rollback runbooks remain outstanding.
requirements.acceptance: A responsible engineer can deploy, operate, investigate and restore the implemented system.

requirements.name: Final scope acceptance
requirements.local_progress: A scope/evidence assessment is available; no independent production acceptance or airline sign-off exists.
requirements.remaining: Product/engineering acceptance must confirm actual deployed scope, exclusions, limitations and unresolved defects.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance confirms claims match tested implemented behavior.
